shortDescription: Manages Primary Storage Pools on Apache CloudStack based clouds.

options.name: allocation_state
options.description: Allocation state of the storage pool.

options.name: api_http_method
options.description: HTTP method used to query the API endpoint. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_METHOD) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_key
options.description: API key of the CloudStack API. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_KEY) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_secret
options.description: Secret key of the CloudStack API. If not set, the C(CLOUDSTACK_SECRET) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: HTTP timeout in seconds. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_TIMEOUT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_url
options.description: URL of the CloudStack API e.g. https://cloud.example.com/client/api. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_ENDPOINT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_verify_ssl_cert
options.description: Verify CA authority cert file. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_VERIFY) env variable is considered.

options.name: capacity_bytes
options.description: Bytes CloudStack can provision from this storage pool.

options.name: capacity_iops
options.description: Bytes CloudStack can provision from this storage pool.

options.name: cluster
options.description: Name of the cluster.

options.name: hypervisor
options.description: Required when creating a zone scoped pool. Possible values are C(KVM), C(VMware), C(BareMetal), C(XenServer), C(LXC), C(HyperV), C(UCS), C(OVM), C(Simulator).

options.name: managed
options.description: Whether the storage pool should be managed by CloudStack. Only considered on creation.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the storage pool.

options.name: pod
options.description: Name of the pod.

options.name: provider
options.description: Name of the storage provider e.g. SolidFire, SolidFireShared, DefaultPrimary, CloudByte.

options.name: scope
options.description: The scope of the storage pool. Defaults to cluster when C(cluster) is provided, otherwise zone.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the storage pool.

options.name: storage_tags
options.description: Tags associated with this storage pool.

options.name: storage_url
options.description: URL of the storage pool. Required if I(state=present).

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_DANGEROUS_NO_TLS_VERIFY) env variable is considered. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: zone
options.description: Name of the zone in which the host should be deployed.
